{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_values = trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].unique()
print("Sentinel values in biomarker_baseline:", sentinel_values)

# Check for duplicates based on patient_id
duplicate_count = trial_df.duplicated(subset=['patient_id'], keep=False).sum()
print("\nDuplicate patient_id count:", duplicate_count)

# Identify which rows have the highest sample_seq for each patient
max_sample_seq = trial_df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print("\nMax sample_seq per patient (first 5):")
print(max_sample_seq.head())

# Keep only the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
trial_df = trial_df.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Now compute the mean of biomarker_baseline
mean_baseline = trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f"\nMean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL): {mean_baseline}")"}
